· Swing resistance ($0.09) + Aligns with current price, potential for short-term bounce on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Sideways) + Lack of directional trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.59x) + Decreased confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + Wait-and-see condition due to absence of clear buy signal.
